name: qb64rust
description: QB64 language support: highlighting, live errors, check, build, run and debug with the new compiler qb64rust (bundled), formatting with QB64pe.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Highlighting works everywhere. Checking, formatting, building and running call the compiler, and the language server runs the qb64rust binary: they need a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Only highlighting works. Checking, formatting, building and running need files on disk and a local compiler.

qb64rust.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Full path to `qb64pe.exe` (or `qb64pe`). When empty, `qb64pe` is looked up on `PATH`.

enumDescriptions: The new compiler qb64rust when it is found (bundled, `qb64rust.path` or PATH), else QB64pe.
Always qb64rust; a build fails when it is not found.
qb64rust.buildWith.markdownDescription: Which compiler **Build**, **Build and Run** and the build task use. `qb64rust` builds with a C++ toolchain: QB64pe's when QB64pe is found, else the one the first build offers to download (`qb64rust.toolchainPath` names one of your own). `qb64pe` needs QB64pe (`qb64rust.compilerPath`).

qb64rust.toolchainPath.markdownDescription: A C++ toolchain folder for building and debugging with `qb64rust` (llvm-mingw's layout: `bin\c++.exe`, `bin\mingw32-make.exe`, `bin\lldb-dap.exe`). When empty, QB64pe's toolchain when QB64pe is found, else the one installed by **QB64: Install the C++ Toolchain** (asked for at the first build: a 190 MB download from github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw).

qb64rust.emsdkPath.markdownDescription: An Emscripten SDK folder for **QB64: Run in Browser** (an `emsdk` folder with release 7.0.0 installed and activated). When empty, the one named by `QB64RUST_EMSDK_ROOT`, else the one installed by **QB64: Install the Emscripten SDK** (asked for at the first run in a browser: an 815 MB download from storage.googleapis.com/webassembly).

qb64rust.path.markdownDescription: Full path to the `qb64rust` binary (the new compiler), which runs the language server (syntax errors as you type, the outline, folding, go to definition, the check on save) and builds. When empty, the binary that comes with the extension, else `qb64rust` on `PATH`.

qb64rust.includeRoot.markdownDescription: Where the language server and a build with `qb64rust` look up `$INCLUDE` files after the including file's folder (`qb64rust --include-root`). When empty, the QB64pe folder (as QB64pe looks in its own folder), else the folder of the `qb64rust` binary. A relative path is resolved against the workspace folder (without a workspace folder it is ignored).

qb64rust.checkOnSave.description: Check the program with the compiler (C++ generation only, no build) when a file is saved.

qb64rust.checkTimeoutSeconds.description: A check or format that runs longer than this is stopped.

qb64rust.format.autoIndent.markdownDescription: Format Document indents each block (QB64pe's IDE setting *Auto indent*, `-f:autoindent`). `auto-indent` in the `[format]` table of a project's `qb64rust.toml` overrides it.

qb64rust.format.indentSize.markdownDescription: Spaces a level of indent (`-f:autoindentsize`). `indent-size` in the `[format]` table of a project's `qb64rust.toml` overrides it.

qb64rust.format.indentSubs.markdownDescription: Indent the body of a `SUB` or `FUNCTION` (`-f:indentsubs`). `indent-subs` in the `[format]` table of a project's `qb64rust.toml` overrides it.

qb64rust.format.autoLayout.markdownDescription: Space each statement and spell its keywords and names (`-f:autolayout`). When off, only the indent changes. `auto-layout` in the `[format]` table of a project's `qb64rust.toml` overrides it.

qb64rust.format.keywordCase.markdownDescription: The case of keywords in Format Document. These settings take the place of QB64pe's `config.ini`, which plays no part in formatting. `keyword-case` (`"camel"`, `"upper"` or `"lower"`) in the `[format]` table of a project's `qb64rust.toml` overrides it, except when the build is QB64pe's.

qb64rust.format.oneStatementPerLine.markdownDescription: Format Document puts each statement of a line packed with colons on a line of its own: `x = 0: y = 0` becomes two lines. A single-line `IF` stays whole. A rewrite moves statements to new line numbers, which `_ERRORLINE` and error messages show. `one-statement-per-line` in the `[format]` table of a project's `qb64rust.toml` overrides it. Not a QB64pe setting: the old compiler's formatter (`qb64pe -y`) ignores it.

qb64rust.format.blockIf.markdownDescription: Format Document writes a single-line `IF` as a block: `IF a THEN x = 1` becomes `If a Then`, `x = 1` one level in, and `End If`. `block-if` in the `[format]` table of a project's `qb64rust.toml` overrides it. Not a QB64pe setting: the old compiler's formatter (`qb64pe -y`) ignores it.

qb64rust.runArguments.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the program by **Run** (visible to it as `COMMAND$`).

qb64rust.noPrompt.markdownDescription: Set `QB64PE_NOPROMPT=y` when running a program, so untrapped runtime errors are printed instead of shown in a dialog.

enumDescriptions: Where the compiler puts it: next to the main file, unless `qb64rust.toml`'s `[build]` table names an `output` folder or has a `copy` list (then `build`).
Next to the main file, as QB64pe builds it, whatever `qb64rust.toml` says. The data files of `[build]` `copy` are not copied.
qb64rust.build.outputFolder.markdownDescription: Where a build with qb64rust puts the program. QB64pe always builds it next to the source.

qb64rust.build.optimize.markdownDescription: Build the program's C++ with optimization (`-f:OptimizeCppProgram=true`). A debug build is never optimized.

qb64rust.build.licenseFile.markdownDescription: Write the licenses of the libraries the program links beside the executable, as `game.exe.license.txt` for `game.exe` (`-f:GenerateLicenseFile=true`). Turn it on before you share a program.

qb64rust.build.extraLinkerFlags.markdownDescription: Flags added to the end of the link command (`-f:ExtraLinkerFlags=...`).

enumDescriptions: A QB64 terminal in VS Code.
A console window of its own. On Linux, the terminal `terminal.external.linuxExec` names, started with `-e`.
qb64rust.run.terminal.markdownDescription: Where **Run** and **Build and Run** start the program.

qb64rust.run.logLevel.markdownDescription: The runtime's log when **Run** starts a program: the lowest level written, as in the QB64pe IDE's logging options. Any level but `none` sets `QB64PE_LOG_LEVEL` and the other three `QB64PE_LOG_*` variables from `#qb64rust.run.logScopes#`, `#qb64rust.run.logHandlers#` and `#qb64rust.run.logFile#`.

qb64rust.run.logScopes.markdownDescription: What the log takes entries from: `qb64` is the program's own `_LOGINFO` and the other log statements; the others are parts of the runtime.

qb64rust.run.logHandlers.markdownDescription: Where the log goes: `console` is the program's standard error, `file` is `#qb64rust.run.logFile#`. With `#qb64rust.run.terminal#` set to `external`, `console` shows only for a `$CONSOLE` program; use `file` for others.

qb64rust.run.logFile.markdownDescription: The log file for the `file` handler; entries are added to its end. Empty is `qb64pe-log.txt`, and a relative path is taken from the folder the program runs in.

qb64rust.tabsNotice.markdownDescription: Say so when a QB64 file shown in an editor has tab characters, and offer to turn them into spaces as the QB64pe IDE does when it loads a file. Tabs inside a string or a `DATA` statement stay.

action.description: Build the program, or run its executable.

file.description: The .bas file. Defaults to the active editor's file.

program.description: The program to debug: its main .bas file, built with qb64rust --debug before the launch, or the executable of a debug build. Defaults to the active file.

args.description: Arguments passed to the program (its COMMAND$). Defaults to qb64rust.runArguments.

cwd.description: The program's working folder. Defaults to the program's folder.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program's first BASIC line.

enumDescriptions: VS Code's integrated terminal: the program's console output and its keyboard input (INPUT) are there.
The Debug Console: output only; the program gets no keyboard input from it.
A terminal window outside VS Code.
console.description: Where a $CONSOLE program reads and writes. A program with a window of its own opens it as when run.

noPrompt.description: Set QB64PE_NOPROMPT=y, so untrapped runtime errors are printed instead of shown in a dialog. Defaults to qb64rust.noPrompt.

configurationSnippets.label: QB64: Debug program
configurationSnippets.description: Build the program with qb64rust --debug and debug it.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:grammar && npm run test:integration && npm run test:integration:min
scripts.package: npm run stage && vsce package --target win32-x64
scripts.package:linux: npm run stage:linux && vsce package --target linux-x64
